scenario.description: A student support coordinator must finalize a tier-three behavior support plan for a seventh-grade student who frequently leaves class, with input from the classroom teacher, behavior specialist, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The school is revising a tier-three behavior support plan for a seventh-grade student who has repeatedly left class without permission.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Bennett is responsible for approving the final plan and its implementation requirements.
shared_context.S3: The current draft calls for ordinary classroom redirection, a weekly progress review, and family contact when staff believe it is needed.
shared_context.S4: The school's student-support routine requires the coordinator to ask the classroom teacher, behavior specialist, and family liaison for relevant information before a behavior plan is approved.

PF1.text: Mr. Ruiz's classroom observations show that the student leaves almost exclusively after unexpected verbal corrections in front of peers; a private, prearranged five-minute regulation break in the library prevents the escalation. He recorded the pattern in his own observation notebook this week, but it has not yet been entered into the team behavior system.

PF2.text: Dr. Shah's completed functional behavior assessment recommends a ten-minute daily reinforcement check using the student's selected activity, rather than waiting for the weekly review; she finalized the assessment yesterday, but the revised recommendation has not yet been attached to the draft plan.

PF3.text: Ms. Okafor confirmed with the family that updates must be sent by text message in Spanish at the end of each school day, because the caregiver cannot reliably receive calls during work hours and requested Spanish communication; she confirmed this during a family meeting this week, but the preference is not yet in the student-support contact record.

acceptance_conditions: Corrections must be delivered privately rather than in front of peers.
The plan must provide a five-minute regulation break in the library.
The plan must include a ten-minute daily reinforcement check.
Family updates must be sent by text message.
Family updates must be in Spanish.
A private-correction and regulation-break implementation commitment must be recorded.
A daily-reinforcement implementation commitment must be recorded.
A family-communication implementation commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'private' in decisions['correction_response'] and ('correction' in decisions['correction_response'] or 'redirection' in decisions['correction_response'] or 'feedback' in decisions['correction_response'])
content_checks.C4: 'text message' in decisions['family_update_method'] and decisions['family_update_language'] == 'Spanish' and ('end of' in decisions['family_update_method'] or any('daily' in c['detail'] or 'end of' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['plan_revision', 'implementation', 'documentation'] and 'daily' in c['detail'] and 'reinforcement' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and decisions['regulation_break_location'] == 'library' and decisions['regulation_break_minutes'] == 5 and any('library' in c['detail'] and ('break' in c['detail'] or 'regulation' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['daily_reinforcement_minutes'] == 10 and any('daily' in c['detail'] or 'every school day' in c['detail'] or 'each school day' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['plan_revision', 'documentation', 'record_keeping'] and 'Spanish' in c['detail'] and ('text' in c['detail'] or 'text message' in c['detail']) and ('end-of-day' in c['detail'] or 'end of each school day' in c['detail'] or 'daily' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The observed public-correction trigger changes the response from ordinary redirection to private correction followed by exactly a five-minute library regulation break.
The functional assessment changes reinforcement from the draft's weekly review to exactly ten minutes every school day and requires that implementation detail to be recorded.
The family's confirmed preference changes updates from discretionary contact to Spanish text messages with daily or end-of-day timing and requires a formal communication commitment.
